description: Build the Faculty Portal: /faculty (directory), /faculty/[id] (faculty profile), /faculty/dashboard (protected: verified faculty + admin), and /admin (protected: admin only). The middleware already enforces role checks for /faculty/dashboard and /admin. SidebarRight should show recent announcements. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004.
steps: 1. Create app/faculty/page.tsx — 'use client'. Faculty directory. Fetches `supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, usn, designation, branch, bio, avatar_url, role, faculty_status, expertise').or('role.eq.faculty,role.eq.admin').order('name').limit(50)`. Filters to only show profiles where `role === 'faculty' || role === 'admin'` (double filter client side for safety). Renders a search input filtering by name or designation. Renders each faculty as a card: UserAvatar (borderColor #ffe066 for verified, #1e3560 otherwise), name, designation, branch, bio snippet, expertise chips, 'Verified Faculty' badge (yellow) if isVerifiedFaculty(). Link each card to /faculty/[id]. Show a 'FACULTY DIRECTORY' page header with the pixel-retro style. Include Navbar. If no faculty found, EmptyState.

2. Create app/faculty/[id]/page.tsx — 'use client'. Individual faculty profile. Fetches full profile by id, shows all faculty-specific fields: name, designation, employee_id (masked: show only last 4 chars), department, bio, expertise chips, avatar. If profile.role is 'student', show a 'Student Profile' fallback (redirect to /people/[id] or show a note). Shows recent announcements by this faculty: `supabase.from('announcements').select('id, title, body, created_at').eq('author_id', id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(5)`. Shows upcoming events hosted by this faculty: `supabase.from('events').select('id, title, event_date, event_time, type').eq('host_id', id).gte('event_date', new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]).order('event_date').limit(5)`. Include Navbar.

3. Create app/faculty/dashboard/page.tsx — 'use client'. Protected by middleware (requires role=faculty/admin with faculty_status=verified). Uses useAuth() to get current profile. Two sections: (A) Announcements management — list own announcements with create/edit/delete. Create: a form with title (text) + body (textarea) that calls `supabase.from('announcements').insert({ author_id: profile.id, title, body })`. Edit: inline edit form. Delete: `supabase.from('announcements').delete().eq('id', id).eq('author_id', profile.id)`. (B) Events management — list own upcoming events with an 'Edit' link (opens CreateEventModal style inline form). The create-event flow can reuse the existing CreateEventModal from components/CreateEventModal.tsx if it can be rendered standalone — if not, create a simple inline form matching the same fields. Also show a summary stat: total RSVPs to their events. Include Navbar.

4. Create app/admin/page.tsx — 'use client'. Protected by middleware (admin role only). Shows faculty applications management. Fetches from `/api/admin/faculty` (GET) which returns all pending+reviewed applications. Renders a table: applicant name, email, designation, department, employee_id, submitted date, status badge. For pending applications: 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons that POST to `/api/admin/faculty/[id]` with `{ decision: 'approved'|'rejected', notes: '' }`. Show a notes input before rejecting. After approve/reject, refresh the list. Also show a section 'Provision First Admin': instruction text explaining that to create the first admin, run `UPDATE public.profiles SET role='admin' WHERE email='your@email.com';` directly in the Supabase SQL editor. This is the documented manual step. Include Navbar.

5. Update components/SidebarRight.tsx to show recent announcements. Currently it shows upcoming events and top showcases. Add a third section 'RECENT ANNOUNCEMENTS' below top showcases. Use `announcements` from useCommunity() context (already fetched in CommunityContext.fetchData). Render the 3 most recent announcements: author name, title, body snippet (50 chars), relative timestamp. Link-style click behavior: `router.push('/')` and `setFeedFilter('announcements')` — wait, 'announcements' is not a FeedFilter type. Looking at the type: `type FeedFilter = 'all' | 'events' | 'discussions' | 'showcases' | 'announcements'`. It IS defined. CommunityContext has announcements in state but the feed filter 'announcements' is in the type — check if page.tsx's filteredPosts handles it. Looking at page.tsx: the filter tabs array does NOT include 'announcements'. Add 'ANNOUNCEMENTS' as a filter tab in app/page.tsx filterTabs array: `{ id: 'announcements', label: `ANNMT (${announcements.length})`, icon: <GraduationCap ...>, activeColor: '#ffe066', activeShadow: '#665500' }`. In filteredPosts and filteredEvents, the 'announcements' filter should return empty arrays for both (announcements are shown separately). The main feed when filter==='announcements' should render the announcements list. Update page.tsx to: (a) add the ANNMT tab, (b) render `announcements.map(...)` in the feed content when `feedFilter === 'announcements'`. Style each announcement like a PostCard but with a faculty badge. SidebarRight: render the top 3 announcements section using inline styles.
6. Run `npm run build` to confirm no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: GET /faculty renders a searchable faculty directory with verified badges
GET /faculty/[id] renders a faculty profile with their announcements and upcoming events
GET /faculty/dashboard (authenticated verified faculty) renders announcements + events management panel
GET /admin (authenticated admin) renders faculty applications with approve/reject actions
app/page.tsx shows an ANNOUNCEMENTS feed filter tab and renders announcements when selected
